pages.text: $(thing)Follow$() (default): walks with you and fights what threatens you. More than 13 blocks behind for 2 seconds, they teleport to your side, even across dimensions or from unloaded chunks. In a fight they finish it, unless you get over 32 blocks away.

$(thing)Guard$(): defends the spot where you set it. They attack enemies up to about 10 blocks from the post (20 with a bow) and then walk back to it. Enemies further away are ignored, unless you order an attack with the $(l:epicvanguard:commanding/war_horn)War Horn$().$(br2)$(thing)Stay$(): stands still and chases nothing, but defends themselves.$(br2)In $(thing)Guard$() or $(thing)Stay$() they never teleport to you. Use the $(l:epicvanguard:reference/commands)call command$() to bring them back.

pages.title: Quick Orders
pages.text: $(thing)Sneak + right-click$() your companion with an empty hand to cycle $(thing)Follow$() → $(thing)Guard$() → $(thing)Stay$() without opening the screen. Guard protects the spot where they are at that moment.$(br2)To command everyone at once, use the $(l:epicvanguard:commanding/war_horn)Vanguard War Horn$().
